title: Floyd-Warshall on 4 vertices (row = from, column = to)

frames.note: Start: the direct edges only (∞ = no edge)
k = 0: allow paths through 0. Row and column 0 (orange) combine; 3 entries improve (red)
k = 1: allow paths through 1. Row and column 1 (orange) combine; 2 entries improve (red)
k = 2: allow paths through 2. Row and column 2 (orange) combine; 3 entries improve (red)
k = 3: allow paths through 3. Row and column 3 (orange) combine; 3 entries improve (red)
Done: every entry is a shortest distance
